environment: maven:3.9.6-eclipse-temurin-21; test harness only; pinned production source unchanged
scope: Production retrieval primitives with controlled granting actions. Up-to quantities before modifiers/payment, per-card optional hand destination, fixed hand retrieval, random retrieval/cancellation and selected physical-card response interventions. Native compare exact event counts, costs, ordered retrieved cards/destinations/Lost order for ten deterministic cases; the two independent-RNG cases compare quantity and response invariants.
limitations: No additional granting card, full-card admission or complete deck is certified by this shared-primitive harness. Full native production admission remains closed.
Lost-card departures/returns and new top cards are controlled response interventions, not separately played movement cards. GEMP retains physical identity; no universal zone-visit policy is inferred.
Random order is not compared between different RNGs. Native tests separately verify persisted first choice, per-card shuffling, entropy failure rollback and response refresh.
Compound-card retrieval counts, fractional quantities, optional-destination modifier providers, broader retrieval restrictions/replacements and failed-search providers remain unfinished.
